Chilla Border Traffic Disruption Due to Protest and Police Checks

The Chilla border experienced significant traffic jams due to a protest by the CJP (Citizens for Justice and Peace). Following a relaxation of restrictions late at night, the border was resealed, leading to police checking vehicles and causing congestion. The protest caused heavy traffic, with police conducting vehicle checks.
